text: An update of the current Strategic Directions (2015-2020) is proposed in response to several significant factors including Toronto Atmospheric Fund (TAF)'s regional expansion, implications associated with designing climate solutions that create broad public benefits (the TransformTO approach) and new insights about TAF's role in helping proven climate solutions reach full-scale adoption. These refreshed Strategic Directions reflect guidance from a working group of external advisors, interviews with key stakeholders, and TAF staff input.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved Toronto Atmospheric Fund's Proposed Strategic Directions (2019-2022) as set out in Attachment 2 to the report (February 7, 2019) from the Chief Executive Officer. 2. Thanked the Strategic Directions Advisory Working Group for their insights and assistance in developing the proposed Strategic Directions.
